input: Compare mortgage refinancing rates from three lenders

gold.taskTitle: Compare Mortgage Refinancing Rates From Three Lenders
gold.taskDescription: Research and compare current mortgage refinancing rates from three different lenders to find the best option.

questions.title: What is your current mortgage balance and home value?
questions.description: Understanding the loan amount and equity helps identify which lenders and rate tiers apply to the user's situation.

questions.title: What type of rate are you targeting, fixed or adjustable?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants a fixed-rate or adjustable-rate mortgage narrows the comparison to relevant products.

questions.title: What loan term length are you considering for refinancing?
questions.description: The desired term (e.g., 10, 15, 20, or 30 years) directly affects the rates offered by lenders.

questions.title: Do you have specific lenders in mind to compare?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has preferred lenders (e.g., current bank, credit unions, online lenders) focuses the research scope.

questions.title: What is your approximate current credit score range?
questions.description: Credit score is a primary factor in the rates a borrower qualifies for and must be known to get accurate comparisons.

questions.title: What is your primary goal — lower monthly payment or total interest?
questions.description: The user's refinancing objective (cash flow relief vs. long-term savings) determines which rate and term combination is best.

questions.title: When do you need this comparison completed by?
questions.description: A deadline helps prioritize the task and determines how quickly lender quotes need to be gathered.
